svg.title: The planning loop
svg.desc: A block diagram of the planning loop. On the left, a dashed box labeled domain.pddl holds a gray box Actions (preconditions, effects), and a dashed box labeled problem.pddl holds gray boxes Initial state (facts true now) and Goal (facts that must hold). Arrows from all three lead to a white box Planner (search plus heuristic), whose arrow leads to a gray box Plan (step 1, step 2, up to step n). An arrow goes down from the plan to a white box Executor (runs one step at a time), then left to a white box Factory (ARIAC). An arrow from the factory returns along the bottom to problem.pddl.

path.aria-label: runs one step at a time
